title: Maryam stepped away from her family to be alone.
subtitle: A devoted worshipper withdraws to the east
then: After Zakariyya's story, the surah turns to Maryam. Ibn Kathir says she came from a good family, was {reward}dedicated by her mother to the service of Allah{/reward}, and was known for her worship. She withdrew from her family to a place on the eastern side of the Sacred House.
now: The house is loud. The phone is louder. You go and sit in the car in the driveway for ten quiet minutes. {idea}Stepping away to be alone with Allah is where this story's miracle begins.{/idea}
old: Taking time alone is a waste when there is so much to do.
new: Withdrawing to be with Allah can be the most important part of my day.
try: Find ten minutes today in a quiet place with no phone, and spend them in dhikr.

title: Behind her screen, an angel appeared as a man.
subtitle: Jibril is sent to Maryam

key.label: What she expected vs what came

then: Maryam hid herself from her people behind a screen. Then Allah sent His Ruh, which the early scholars say means {idea}Jibril{/idea}. He came to her in the form of a perfect, complete man.
now: You sit down for an ordinary moment of worship. Nothing seems special about the evening. {reward}Some of the biggest turns in a life arrive in exactly those quiet, private hours.{/reward}
old: Nothing big happens in my small private moments with Allah.
new: The hidden hour of worship is where Allah's plans often begin.
try: Keep one small private act of worship today that only Allah sees.

title: Afraid, she sought refuge in the Most Merciful.
subtitle: Her first defense was reminding him of Allah
then: Alone, Maryam saw a man and feared he meant to harm her. {idea}The first thing she did was seek refuge in Allah and try to make him fear Allah.{/idea} Abu Wa'il said she knew a God-fearing person would hold back from evil.
now: A message that feels threatening. A man in the car park who will not leave you alone. {trap}Your heart is pounding.{/trap} Maryam's first move was to say Allah's name, and to call on the other person's conscience.
old: When I am scared, there is no time to think of Allah.
new: Turning to Allah first, out loud, is itself a defense.
try: Memorize a short line of seeking refuge, like a'udhu billah, for moments of fear.

title: I am only your Lord's messenger, bringing a pure son.
subtitle: The angel calms her fear
then: Ibn Kathir says the angel answered {idea}to remove the fear she felt{/idea}: I am not what you think, I am your Lord's messenger. He had come with the gift of a pure, righteous son.
now: The unknown number keeps calling, and you assume the worst. A letter with an official stamp sits unopened on the table. {reward}Sometimes the thing you are dreading is carrying good news.{/reward}
new: What scares me at first may turn out to be a gift sent by Allah.
try: Open one thing you have been avoiding out of fear today, with bismillah.

title: How, when no man has touched me?
subtitle: Maryam's honest question about her own purity
then: Maryam was amazed. Ibn Kathir explains her words as: {idea}in what way would a son come to me{/idea}, when I have no husband and have done nothing wrong? Like Zakariyya before her, she asked how.
now: Life hands you something that does not fit any category you know. You are allowed to say: I do not understand how this works. {idea}Maryam's question is honest, and it is answered.{/idea}
old: Asking how something can be means I am resisting Allah.
new: I can bring my honest questions to Allah and still accept His decree.
try: Write down one question you have about your situation, and ask Allah to show you.

title: Easy for Allah: a sign for people and a mercy.
subtitle: Why Isa would be born without a father

picture.label: Four ways to create a human

then: The angel said it is easy for Allah. Ibn Kathir explains Isa would be {idea}a sign of Allah's power{/idea}: Adam had no parents, Hawwa came from a male, the rest of us from both, and Isa from a mother alone. It was a matter already decreed.
now: Your life is taking a shape you did not plan, and people around you will have opinions. {reward}What looks strange from outside may be exactly what Allah intended, and a mercy.{/reward}
old: If my story looks unusual, something must have gone wrong.
new: Allah can make an unusual path into a sign and a mercy.
try: Say to yourself today about one unplanned turn: this was already decreed, and Allah is merciful.

title: She accepted the decree and carried it far away.
subtitle: Pregnancy, rumors, and a remote place
then: Ibn Kathir says Maryam {reward}accepted the decree of Allah{/reward} and conceived. Ibn Ishaq describes her pregnancy sickness and how {trap}word spread among the people{/trap}. She hid herself away and withdrew to a far place.
now: You said yes to something you believe is from Allah: a hard marriage, a sick parent to care for, a move. And then the talk started at family gatherings. {idea}Accepting the decree did not make Maryam's road easy.{/idea}
old: If this is really from Allah, it should feel easy.
new: Accepting Allah's decree can still mean a hard, lonely road.
try: Send a kind message to someone carrying something hard that others gossip about.

title: In labor pain she said: I wish I had died before this.
subtitle: Even the best can reach the edge
then: The pains of labor drove her to the trunk of a date palm. Ibn Kathir says she knew {trap}people would not help her or believe her story{/trap}, after being known as a devout worshipper. She wished she had been nothing, forgotten.
now: Two in the morning, in pain, sure that everyone will judge you, you say: I cannot do this anymore. {idea}Allah put Maryam's same words in the Quran.{/idea} Hitting that wall does not mean you are far from Him.
old: If I ever feel like giving up, I have failed as a believer.
new: Even Maryam reached the edge, and Allah's help came right after.
try: If you are at the edge today, tell Allah exactly how you feel, then tell one trusted person.

title: Do not grieve: a stream is already beneath you.
subtitle: Comfort arrives at her lowest point
then: A voice called from below her. Some scholars say it was Jibril, others say Isa. It said {idea}do not grieve{/idea}: your Lord has placed a stream beneath you. Al-Bara and Ibn Abbas said the word means a small river for her to drink.
now: You feel completely alone. Then the neighbor knocks with food, or a friend calls at the right minute. {reward}The help was already near; you just could not see it from the floor.{/reward}
old: When I hit bottom, nobody and nothing is there for me.
new: Allah's provision can already be beneath me when I feel most alone.
try: Look around today and name one help you already have that you overlooked.

title: Shake the trunk, and fresh dates will fall.
subtitle: Allah provides, and she still has a part to play
then: She was told to grab the trunk of the date palm and shake it toward herself. {reward}Allah blessed her with food and drink.{/reward} Amr bin Maymun said nothing is better for a woman after childbirth than dates.
now: You are worn out after a long week and the job search feels pointless. One more application. One phone call. {idea}A tired woman could not truly shake a palm tree, yet she was told to try.{/idea}
old: My little effort is too small to make any difference.
new: Allah asks for my small effort and then sends the provision Himself.
try: Do one small step today on something you have been waiting on.

title: Eat, drink, be at peace, and let silence speak.
subtitle: She does not have to defend herself
then: She was told to eat, drink and be glad. If anyone came, she should signal that she had vowed a fast of silence to the Most Merciful. Ibn Kathir says {idea}her affair would be taken care of and her proof established{/idea}.
now: The family group chat is full of questions about you. You draft a long reply, delete it, draft again. {idea}Sometimes the strongest answer is to eat, rest, and let Allah show the truth.{/idea}
old: If I do not defend myself to everyone, they will believe the worst.
new: I can stay calm and quiet and trust Allah to clear my name.
try: Skip one argument today where you feel you must justify yourself.
